gloss: to peel off; to come off (skin, bark)

definitions.gloss: to peel off; to come off; to flake off
definitions.explanation: For skin, bark, paint, or a surface layer to come off naturally or due to damage. An intransitive verb — the peeling happens on its own.

examples.japanese: {日焼|ひや}けで{皮|かわ}が{剥|む}けた。
examples.english: My skin peeled from the sunburn.

examples.japanese: {壁|かべ}のペンキが{剥|む}けてきた。
examples.english: The paint on the wall has started to peel off.

examples.japanese: {鼻|はな}の{頭|あたま}の{皮|かわ}が{剥|む}けて{赤|あか}くなっている。
examples.english: The skin on the tip of my nose has peeled off and turned red.

notes:
Describes surfaces, coatings, or skin coming off naturally or as a result of damage. As an intransitive verb, the peeling happens on its own without someone actively removing it.

TRANSITIVE PAIR:
- {剥|む}ける (intransitive) — to peel off (by itself)
- {剥|む}く (transitive) — to peel (something)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {皮|かわ}が{剥|む}ける — skin peels
- ペンキが{剥|む}ける — paint peels off
- {塗装|とそう}が{剥|む}ける — coating peels off

CONTRAST WITH {剥|は}がれる:
- {剥|む}ける — for thin layers like skin, bark, paint
- {剥|は}がれる — for things stuck or attached coming off (labels, stickers, wallpaper)
